entries.original: 'every legal opponent reply drops eval_cp by at least 80 cp'
entries.actual: under minimax the searched value of a move already equals the opponent's best reply, so the literal rule is vacuous
entries.resolution: interpretation: every searched reply is >= 80 cp worse for the opponent than the static (depth-1) evaluation of the resulting position

entries.actual: deliberately walking to the 99th half-move risks a 50-move draw claim if any step is miscounted; it also conflicts with #1/#177 anti-draw
entries.resolution: implemented only as a reward for a mate that happens exactly at halfmove 99 inside the soundness gate (mate obligation keeps mating moves); no forced delay
entries.remaining: the 'delay' half is not implemented (forced mate obligation wins arbitration)
